newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian May new car registrations rose 43.23 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italian May new car registrations rose 43.23 pct.

text.p: Italian new car registrations rose 43.23 percent to 232,600 units in May, compared with 162,399 in May 1996, the Ministry of Transport said.
New car registrations in May for the Fiat group rose 45.2 percent to 101,600 from May 1996.
Fiat group Italian new car registrations in April 1997 were 103,950.
For the total Italian car market, new car registrations rose 0.47 percent in May from April 1997.
In the first five months of 1997, new car registration rose to 1,089,600, showing a rise of 27.9 percent on the same period of 1996.
In the January-May period, Fiat group signelled a rise in registration of 24.5 percent to 472,155 units.

NOTE - Fiat comprises Fiat, Alfa Romeo, Lancia Autobianchi, and Fiat-Innocenti. Volkswagen comprises VW, Audi, Skoda and Seat. General Motors comprises Opel and Saab. PSA-Peugeot comprises Peugeot and Citroen. BMW comprises BMW and Rover.
